channel.title: Fossa Changelog
channel.description: Latest Fossa updates, improvements, and releases.

item.title: September 26, 2026 - Native Multi-Provider LLM & Fallback Failover
item.description:
What's new

Native Multi-Provider LLM Support

Fossa now provides first-class native support for all major AI providers directly through environment variables and in-app BYOK settings. Configure Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints with zero proxy wrappers.

Intelligent Fallback Failover Engine

If your primary model encounters rate limits (429 HTTP), quota exhaustion, or vendor downtime, Fossa automatically fails over to your designated secondary model without interrupting PR code reviews.

Per-Repository Model Routing

Route cost-effective models to simple documentation or UI repositories, while assigning frontier reasoning models to core backend and security-critical repositories.

Bug Fixes

Fixed streaming chunk buffering on massive multi-file pull request diffs and normalized reasoning parameters across Anthropic and Google Gemini APIs.

item.title: September 20, 2026 - Hardened Production Self-Hosted Docker Stack
item.description:
What's new

Unified Production Docker Stack

Single-command Docker Compose orchestration powering the NestJS REST API, asynchronous worker, webhook relay, and Next.js 15 dashboard with automated health checks.

RabbitMQ Quorum Queues

Guaranteed message delivery with delayed retry exchanges and transactional outbox relay pattern across distributed services.

Automated Database Schema Evolution

TypeORM PostgreSQL and MongoDB migrations run automatically on container startup with connection pool self-healing.

Bug Fixes

Resolved worker inbox claim lock contention under rapid consecutive git push events and optimized Postgres pool connections under heavy concurrency.

item.title: September 14, 2026 - Fossy Rules Studio & Review Directives
item.description:
What's new

Conversational Rule Learning

Fossy detects team conventions discussed inside PR review threads and prompts developers to persist them as active Fossy Rules with 1-click confirmation.

Hierarchical Inheritance & Dry Run Previews

Define rules at the Organization level with repository overrides via fossa-config.yml, and test rule precision against historical PR diffs in Dry Run mode.

Bug Fixes

Corrected glob pattern matching on deeply nested test files and added optimistic UI updates when toggling rule inheritance.

item.title: September 8, 2026 - Cockpit Developer Hub & Review Telemetry
item.description:
What's new

Cockpit Engineering Dashboard

Centralized hub tracking active pull request reviews, suggestion acceptance rate, turnaround time, and detected quality issues across all connected repositories.

Shareable Filter States

Synchronize Cockpit filters directly to browser URLs for seamless team sharing across Slack, Teams, and Discord.

Token Usage & Spend Visibility

Comprehensive telemetry tracking prompt and completion tokens across providers, models, and teams in real time.

Bug Fixes

Fixed timezone display offset on velocity graphs and enhanced team RBAC policy isolation.

item.title: September 1, 2026 - Fossa 2.0 Open Source Platform Launch
item.description:
What's new

Fossa 2.0 General Availability

Full open-source launch of the next-generation AI code review platform. Built for complete data privacy with on-premise Docker deployment and Bring-Your-Own-Key architecture.

Universal Git Provider Support

First-party support for GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure Repos, and Forgejo.

Fossa CLI

Run automated reviews and architectural checks directly from developer terminals before pushing code.

Bug Fixes

Initial release stabilization, optimized Docker container layers, and standardized linting rules.
